# Classic Fantasy Novels for Young Adults

Discover a selection of highly acclaimed fantasy series, perfect for young adult readers aged 12-16, with roots stretching back before the year 2000. These foundational tales offer rich worlds, compelling characters, and completed narratives that have captivated generations.

## Recommended Series Starters

Here are five excellent options to begin an epic reading journey:

### The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (The Chronicles of Narnia)
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- **Summary:** Four siblings discover a magical world through a wardrobe, where they must help the noble lion Aslan defeat the evil White Witch.
- **Key Attribute:** An allegorical tale of courage, sacrifice, and the eternal struggle between good and evil, packed with memorable characters and creatures.
Action: [Learn More]: https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/100915.The_Lion_the_Witch_and_the_Wardrobe

### A Wizard of Earthsea (Earthsea Cycle)
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- **Summary:** Young Ged, a gifted but proud wizard, unleashes a terrible shadow creature upon the world and must embark on a perilous journey to set things right.
- **Key Attribute:** A deeply philosophical coming-of-age story set in a vast archipelago, exploring themes of balance, responsibility, and self-discovery.
Action: [Learn More]: https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/13642.A_Wizard_of_Earthsea

### The Hobbit
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- **Summary:** Bilbo Baggins, a respectable hobbit, is unexpectedly swept away on an adventure with a company of dwarves and the wizard Gandalf to reclaim a lost treasure from a fearsome dragon.
- **Key Attribute:** A foundational quest narrative that introduced Middle-earth, filled with riddles, trolls, elves, and the beginnings of a much larger world.
Action: [Learn More]: https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/5907.The_Hobbit

### The Book of Three (The Prydain Chronicles)
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- **Summary:** Taran, an assistant pig-keeper, dreams of heroic deeds and finds himself on an unexpected adventure that will shape the destiny of the magical land of Prydain.
- **Key Attribute:** A classic fantasy series inspired by Welsh mythology, following Taran's journey from humble beginnings to a true hero.
Action: [Learn More]: https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/24780.The_Book_of_Three

### The Dark Is Rising (The Dark Is Rising Sequence)
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- **Summary:** On his eleventh birthday, Will Stanton discovers he is the last of the Old Ones, an ancient race with powers to fight the rising forces of the Dark.
- **Key Attribute:** A richly atmospheric and suspenseful tale blending Arthurian legend with modern fantasy, steeped in ancient magic and folklore.
Action: [Learn More]: https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/75949.The_Dark_Is_Rising
